2022 PERFORMANCE REVIEW                                                   2022年度業績回顧

In 2022, despite the pandemic having caused relatively material impact    2022年，儘管疫情對經濟運行產生了較
on economic operation, the catering and other contact-type services       大衝擊，但隨着第四季度疫情防控政策
industries that were heavily affected in the early-pandemic period        優化落實、消費場景有序恢復，前期受
began to improve, along with the optimization and implementation of       疫情影響較大的餐飲等接觸型服務消費
the latest pandemic prevention and control policies and the orderly       開始有所改善，消費市場發展整體呈現
recovery of consumption scenes in the fourth quarter. The overall         恢復向好趨勢。
development of the consumption market showed a positive recovering
trend.

During the past year, the Group focused its main business on              2022 年，本集團主要業務重點為加強
enhancing the building and management of channel expansion,               渠道拓展建設與管理，優化產品研發機
optimizing the product research and development mechanism,                制，繼續落實多品牌戰略，同時新增自
continuously implementing the multi-brand strategy, while at the          有產能優化供應能力。
same time increasing its self-production capacity to optimize supply
capability.

With respect of channel building, the Group further strengthened the      在渠道建設方面，本集團進一步加強渠
refined and standardised channel management. On the basis of sub-         道精細化、標準化管理，在分渠道管理

COMPANY’S CULTURE                                                            企業文化

The Board believes that corporate culture underpins the long-term            董事會認為，企業文化乃本集團的發展
business, economic success and sustainable growth of the Group. A            基石，有利於本集團作長遠的業務發展
strong culture enables the Company to deliver long-term sustainable          及取得經濟成就，亦有助持續的增長。
performance and fulfill its role as a responsible corporate citizen.         深厚的企業文化令本公司能夠保持基業
The Company is committed to developing a positive and progressive            長青，同時成為一名負責任、有擔當的
culture that is built on its purpose, values and strategy.                   企業公民。基於其目標、價值和戰略，
                                                                             本公司致力於建立健全積極進取的企業
                                                                             文化。

During 2022, the Company continued to strengthen its cultural                2022年，本公司通過聚焦以下幾方面的
framework by focusing on the following:                                      努力，繼續加強文化建設：

and “ double carbon ” target. We set up annual energy and water              每年設定能源水源節約項目，逐年降低

       Mandatory Disclosure Requirements
       強制披露規定

       Governance Structure:                                                                 Board Statement
       A statement from the board containing the following elements:
       (i)   a disclosure of the board’s oversight of ESG issues;
       (ii) the board’s ESG management approach and strategy, including the
             process used to evaluate, prioritise and manage material ESG-related
             issues (including risks to the issuer’s businesses); and
       (iii) how the board reviews progress made against ESG-related goals and
             targets with an explanation of how they relate to the issuer’s businesses.
       管治架構：                                                                                 董事會聲明
       由董事會發出的聲明，當中載有下列內容：
       (i)   披露董事會對環境、社會及管治事宜的監管；
       (ii) 董事會的環境、社會及管治管理方針及策略，包括評估、優次排列及管理重
             要的環境、社會及管治相關事宜（包括對發行人業務的風險）的過程；及
       (iii) 董事會如何按環境、社會及管治相關目標檢討進度、並解釋它們如何與發行
             人業務有關連。

       A description of, or an explanation of, the application of the Reporting Principles   About the Report
       (Materiality, Quantitative and Consistency) in the preparation of the ESG report.
       描述或解釋在編備環境、社會及管治報告時如何應用匯報原則（重要性、量化和一                                                  關於本報告
       致性）。

       A narrative explaining the reporting boundaries of the ESG report and describing      About the Report
       the process used to identify which entities or operations are included in the ESG
       report. If there is a change in the scope, the issuer should explain the difference
       and reason for the change.
       解釋環境、社會及管治報告的匯報範圍，及描述挑選哪些實體或業務納入環境、社                                                  關於本報告
       會及管治報告的過程。若匯報範圍有所改變，發行人應解釋不同之處及變動原因。

34. RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS                                           34. 關聯方交易

   Parties are considered to be related if one party has the ability,         如一方有能力直接或間接控制另一
   directly or indirectly, to control the other party or exercise             方或對另一方作出財務及經營決策
   significant influence over the other party in making financial             行使重大影響力，則各方被視為有
   and operation decisions. Parties are also considered to be                 關聯。如彼等受共同控制，各方亦
   related if they are subject to common control. Members of key              被視為有關聯。本集團主要管理層
   management and their close family member of the Group are also             成員及其近親亦被視為關聯方。
   considered as related parties.

                                                                              定。
